handoff.summary: #6f ledger auto-append CLOSED — both producers shipped (verify --record + task-completion gate)
handoff.done:
**Backlog #6f-2 — task-completion gate records to the ledger by default** (commit 84e99e4, pushed + CI-verified green run 27647982908 conclusion=success). The SECOND automatic run-ledger producer, completing the ledger auto-append gap that has been open since cycle/lesson shipped. `socom gate task-completion <promise.xml>` now records its assessment to .socom/ledger/runs.jsonl — verdict kept iff the bound fast check passed, the canonical "a gate assessed the promise -> kept/broken" event (schemas/ledger.xml). So `socom cycle`/`lesson` fill with REAL done-attempts WITHOUT a manual flag — the done-gate an agent already runs is the producer.
Built on one SHARED writer `_append_ledger_row` (one wire format + one attempt sequence, §least-common-mechanism) + a pure `_promise_ref`; the #6f-1 verify --record path was refactored onto them (behavior-preserving). No promise arg -> behaviour unchanged. A broken attempt records BEFORE the RED exit (failed done-attempts are the pass@1-vs-pass@k signal). Fail-closed: standalone / manual-pending / zero-auto-check / UNBOUND-gate all record nothing — no real check ran, so a vacuous "kept" is forbidden (§separation-of-privilege + verify-never-claim). unit 60->66, +5 smoke checks.
Independent reviewer ACCEPT-WITH-NITS, 8/8 contract checks. Caught a real class defect: `_gate_record` AND `cmd_contract` caught only ET.ParseError, so a DIRECTORY arg raised an uncaught IsADirectoryError, crashing a PASSING gate into a false RED. Fixed the class at BOTH parse sites (catch OSError too) + added a directory-arg smoke case; re-ran full gate green before commit.
**Context — two-producer arc:** #6f-1 (commit 927905d, prior closeout ecb3e9e) shipped `contract verify --record` (on-demand producer); #6f-2 (84e99e4) shipped the gate producer (by-default). Together they CLOSE the long-open "ledger only measures synthetic data" gap from both altitudes. Earlier same arc this session: #7 commit-protocol->canon (11ad743, closeout c90db3a).
handoff.undone: #6f-3 (NOT built — the measurement-surface remainder): per-contract pass@1/pass@k in cmd_cycle (cycle currently groups by seat + promise, not by contract); standalone `.socom/contracts/<id>.xml` storage + lifecycle; §R10 renegotiation (new version + originator re-ratification + diff). Known acceptable interaction (worth a doctrine line someday, NOT a bug): if a promise is recorded by BOTH `verify --record` and the task-completion gate, two rows accrue (attempt 1, 2) — distinct assessments, cycle treats them as sequential attempts. SM-3 remainder (cmd_gate CC / render_body CC) — decompose only if they bite. #7b commit-protocol .gitmessage scaffold — only if wanted.

handoff.warnings: - .socom/ledger/runs.jsonl is now a LIVE artifact once any agent runs `verify --record` or `gate task-completion <promise>`. It is append-only and in-repo (§git-is-source-of-truth); a row is never edited, a correction is a new row. cycle reads every row — a malformed row would RED cycle, so only the two writers (one shared `_append_ledger_row`) should write it. - .socom/index/chunks.jsonl churn on pre-push `full` (runs `socom index .`): pre-existing non-stable-output behaviour, left as documented churn. - CI carries the known Node-20 deprecation annotation (maintenance debt, commit b28ada4) — actions forced to Node-24 from 2026-06-16 (today). Not a blocker.
